BL-762 — Bedtime runs the lights-out stop, so the phone loses its origin and Bubble reads as dead
What it solves: Keep-vs-kill matrix, derived 2026-07-31 from the scripts themselves rather
than from the intake's prose. `stop-swarm.sh` runs
`stop_ancillary_services.sh` (babysitterd, operator runtime, Telegram front
desk, onboarder, remote tunnels) and then `kill_pipeline_swarm.sh` (agent
sessions + handoffd), t…
Approval context: One decision worth a tap: whether the **onboarder** belongs in bedtime's stop set. I put it there — it is a supervised poll loop that burns tokens, which is what bedtime exists to stop — but unlike babysitterd it cannot revive a seat, so keeping it would be defensible if you ever want overnight onb…
BL-762 needs your approval before it can proceed. Reply here with "approve BL-762" (or "reject BL-762 <reason>") to act.
